body:
Bake up some magical memories with your little one this holiday season! The dadada Toddler Tower lets your toddler safely join you at the counter, turning every cookie-making moment into a fun, hands-on experience.

This festive Sprinkle Cookie recipe is from YummyToddlerFood.com and was recently brought to life by influencer Alison Palecek, who baked up a batch full of holiday cheer! We are using sprinkles for this batch, but feel free to switch up your sprinkles to match any celebration!


What You’ll Need:

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour (or gluten-free baking mix)
  • 1/2 cup granulated sugar
  • 1/2 tsp baking powder
  • 1/4 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened (or softened coconut oil for dairy-free)
  • 2-3 tbsp milk (or non-dairy milk)
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Sprinkles of your choice

Instructions:

  1. Combine all ingredients except sprinkles in a bowl. Mix until dough forms, adding more milk if needed.
  2. Roll dough into balls, coat with sprinkles, and place on a lined baking sheet.
  3. Flatten each ball slightly and refrigerate while preheating the oven to 350°F.
  4. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the bottoms are lightly golden. Cool before serving.

These cookies can be stored at room temperature for 3-5 days or frozen for up to 3 months. Swap the sprinkles for any holiday or celebration to make this recipe a year-round favorite!


Here’s to starting sweet traditions together, one sprinkle at a time. Capture those special moments in the kitchen and share them with us on socials using the hashtag #dadadamoment - we can’t wait to see what you create!
